timing_disclosure.reason_v1_generic_status_is_not_reused: The generic promoter requires FROZEN_BEFORE_NUMERIC_RUN, which would falsely backdate these identities after individual units had begun.

purpose: Bind the four Wave1 recovery2 method identities before any complete seed or method-level result exists, while retaining every numeric and denominator gate from the generic local-result admission contract.

only_code_changes: required identity status FROZEN_BEFORE_NUMERIC_RUN becomes the truthful FROZEN_BEFORE_COMPLETE_SEED_RESULTS
output schema version changes from agentenhance.wma_local_result_admission.v2 to agentenhance.wma_local_result_admission.v3
unchanged_numeric_gates: 150 observed of 150 expected samples with zero failures per seed
every value exactly matches both raw aggregate and combined summary
terminal-accepted inventories for summary and every seed aggregate
no official or source-reported numeric values

output.execution_condition: All four recovery2 method summaries, the complete table projection, and the raw accepted-evidence archive are terminal-accepted and independently verified.
output.archive_condition: Archive the accepted admission bundle as a small immutable evidence overlay before any project-owned model cleanup.

failure_rule: Any identity, inventory, denominator, raw-value, summary-value, method-registration, or terminal-state mismatch rejects the fresh admission root; never patch an output or omit a failed method after seeing results.
claim_boundary: This freeze admits no result. Later accepted rows support only local matched-protocol comparisons; SOTA wording requires a separately audited comparison claim with an explicit metric and comparator scope.
